user.title: Surveillance Station
user.description: Use a dedicated DSM account whose Surveillance Station privilege profile allows playback and download. Two-step verification must be off for it.

reauth_confirm.title: Surveillance Station login
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {username} was rejected. Enter the current one.

reconfigure.title: Surveillance Station
reconfigure.description: Change the address or the DSM account. It must be the same NAS.

error.no_cameras: Logged in, but this account sees no cameras. Check its Surveillance Station privilege profile.
error.unsupported: This Surveillance Station lacks Web APIs the integration needs (the log names them). Update it to Surveillance Station 9.
error.otp_required: This account needs a two-step verification code. Turn two-step verification off for this dedicated account, or exempt it from a policy that enforces it.

abort.already_configured: This Surveillance Station is already configured.
abort.wrong_device: That is a different NAS than the one this entry was set up for.

invalid_auth.message: Surveillance Station rejected the login. Re-enter the password to continue.

init.title: Frigate detections and video
init.description: Turn Frigate's review items into Surveillance Station bookmarks (needs the MQTT integration, connected to Frigate's broker). Frigate cameras are matched to Surveillance Station cameras by name (ignoring case, spaces and punctuation); the next step maps those whose names differ. Each new bookmark also fires a surveillance_station_detection event, for an automation to send a notification. Last, how video is transcoded.

data.frigate_link: Dashboard path of the timeline card

data_description.frigate_topic: Frigate's mqtt.topic_prefix; reviews are read from this prefix's /reviews topic.
data_description.frigate_link: For example /ss-playback/playback. The event then carries a link that opens the card at the detection.
data_description.frigate_url: Frigate's API as Home Assistant reaches it, such as http://frigate:5000 (the internal port, no login). With it, a notification's image is Frigate's snapshot of the object, box drawn, and it is sent a few seconds sooner; without it, the Surveillance Station frame of that moment.
data_description.frigate_objects: Frigate labels. A review with any of them is bookmarked, alert or detection. Animals (dog, cat, bird, …) are all named Animal.
data_description.frigate_quiet_minutes: No surveillance_station_detection event for a camera's review when it has only kinds chosen below, all seen on that camera within this many minutes (the dog that wandered off and came back); it is still bookmarked. 0: every review.
data_description.frigate_quiet_kinds: People are never quiet: a second person arriving is always announced.
data_description.transcoder: What transcodes video (today the time-lapse; playback and live are not transcoded). Automatic: an Intel GPU (QSV) where Home Assistant has a usable one, the CPU otherwise; a GPU that is there but busy means trying again, not the CPU. GPU only: never the CPU - no time-lapse without a GPU. CPU only: never the GPU. On the CPU it is H.264, at low priority and on half the cores: a 4K time-lapse keeps up with little to spare, and seeks are slower.

cameras.title: Frigate cameras
cameras.description: For each Surveillance Station camera whose name doesn't match its Frigate camera's (ignoring case, spaces and punctuation), enter the Frigate camera's name as in Frigate's config (several: separate them with commas). Leave the others empty.

error.invalid_topic: Enter a topic prefix without wildcards.
error.invalid_link: Enter a path starting with /, such as /ss-playback/playback.
error.duplicate_camera: A Frigate camera can go to one Surveillance Station camera only.
error.invalid_url: Enter an http:// or https:// URL, such as http://frigate:5000.

frigate_mqtt.title: Frigate detections: MQTT is not available
frigate_mqtt.description: Home Assistant's MQTT integration has not been available for over 10 minutes, so Frigate reviews on `{topic}/reviews` are not being turned into Surveillance Station bookmarks or notifications. Check the MQTT integration and its broker; this clears by itself once MQTT is back.

frigate_failing.title: Frigate detections are not being bookmarked
frigate_failing.description: Surveillance Station has refused or failed every Frigate review for over 10 minutes, so detections get no bookmark and no notification. Last error: {error}. This clears by itself once a bookmark goes through.

frigate_offline.title: Frigate is offline
frigate_offline.description: Frigate has reported itself offline on `{topic}/available` for over 10 minutes, so nothing is being detected. Check the Frigate container; this clears by itself once Frigate is back online.
